user.title: Connect Plowshare profiles
user.description: Select an explicit agent for each enabled platform. Control-off routes to the read-only agent and AI Task uses its own selection. Actual permissions come from Plowshare Application grants; these declarations do not remove tools from an arbitrarily configured agent.

data.read_only_agent: Read-only Conversation agent (required when control is off)
data.agent: Control Conversation agent (required when control is on)
data.task_agent: AI Task agent (required when AI Task is enabled)
data.allow_anonymous: Allow voice sources without a Home Assistant user

reconfigure.title: Update house assistant connection
reconfigure.description: Rotate the token or adjust waits and prompt settings. Different platform routes require another integration. Token changes fence retained conversations until their earlier work is inspected; they never repeat uncertain work.

error.invalid_config: Check enabled platforms, their explicit agent selections, server origin, Application and wait values. HA LLM tool APIs are unsupported.
error.cannot_connect: Plowshare could not complete the connection check, or connection cleanup has not settled. Check server availability and project access.
error.validation_busy: Connection validation is busy. Wait for pending cleanup or server capacity before trying again; no model work was requested.

abort.already_configured: This house agent is already configured.
